qualification.details: Para Pump Operator: Matriculation (10th) with ITI certificate in Electrician/Wireman/Diesel Mechanic/Pump Mechanic/Motor Mechanic/Pump Operator cum Mechanic/Mechanic (Motor Vehicle)/Pump Operation-cum-Mechanic/Pump Operation and Maintenance from a recognized ITI or matriculation (10th) with certificate in above trades under Skill Development scheme of the Government. Para Fitter: Matriculation (10th) with ITI certificate in Fitter/Plumber from a recognized ITI or matriculation (10th) with certificate in above trades under Skill Development scheme of the Government. Multipurpose Worker: Minimum qualification of middle pass (8th) and its equivalent from school duly recognized by the State Government.

Read the official notification carefully before applying.
